name: Tegid Voel

attributes.attribute: an obscure Welsh god or giant
the consort of the hag goddess Ceridwen
had a lake named for him, now called Lake Bala

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tegid Voel is an obscure Welsh god. He is also called Tegid Foel or Tegyd Foel. Some call him a giant. He was the consort of the hag goddess Ceridwen. Little else is known of him. The lake where the pair made their home bore his name. That lake is now Lake Bala.

okr.objective: Describe the Welsh god Tegid Voel.
key_results: He was the consort of the hag goddess Ceridwen.
He is known from little more than the lake that bore his name.
That lake is now known as Lake Bala.
